Sending company data to ChatGPT is a confidentiality concern because any data or code sent to the platform is likely to be used for subsequent training, which raises issues regarding the confidentiality of corporate data and intellectual property. This means that sensitive information could be exposed or misused.

In response to the data leak incident where Samsung employees leaked sensitive information while using ChatGPT, the company banned the use of this generative AI internally and plans to develop its own AI.
